## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak sector breadth (4/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 of top performers are Tech), with major-cap divergences (AAPL, MSFT, JPM showing 1W ≠ 1M) — supports a neutral, mixed market tone.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy: XOM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -9.80%) RECOVERY; CVX (1W: +3.17% | 1M: -8.78%) RECOVERY; MPC (1W: +8.89% | 1M: -1.37%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples: CVS (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND; MDLZ (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate: VTR (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +7.73%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication: CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +24.75%) CORRECTION. Materials: FCX (1W: -19.09% | 1M: +4.40%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary: SHOP (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +8.49%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND; TXN (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +44.42%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +71.96%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -19.09% | 1M: +4.40%) CORRECTION; NOW (1W: -13.76% | 1M: -15.32%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +18.45%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -4.28%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and select Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +45.17%); QCOM (1W: +14.65%); TXN (1W: +13.93%); AMD (1W: +11.09%); CVS (1W: +10.74%). Note MAJOR divergence: megacaps AAPL, MSFT, JPM have 1W ≠ 1M (AAPL, MSFT, JPM in CORRECTION) — tactical caution; suppress any one-sided regime calls.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but strong pockets: NVDA (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +26.69%) ABOVE TREND; GOOGL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +27.95%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +30.90%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: +9.54%) CORRECTION; MSFT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +18.25%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -0.13% vs 1M: +20.61% — leadership narrow and internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed to mildly constructive: V (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +9.54%) CORRECTION. Financials 1W: -0.79% | 1M: +9.67% — showing 1M strength but near-term dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft overall with select strength: UNH (1W: +4.87% | 1M: +41.62%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -6.24%) RECOVERY; LLY (1W: -7.63% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare 1W: -1.85% | 1M: -0.29% — defensive names mixed, watch earnings/drug headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to cyclical pockets showing clear follow-through (Intel/semis, large-cap Energy and select REITs) and reduce exposure to over-concentrated Tech laggards and names with rapid 1W reversals; Style: mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor megacap divergences (AAPL, MSFT, JPM) before committing incremental risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +45.17% | 1M: +130.03%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +26.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -19.09% | 1M: +4.40%) CORRECTION; NOW (1W: -13.76% | 1M: -15.32%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -3.46%) — RECOVERY signals across large caps; Real Estate (VTR ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Communication (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -3.95%) and Materials (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +5.05%) — watch for continued outflows.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for sustained trading above recent breakout highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; INTC: monitor follow-through after the 1W surge — failure to hold gains would signal reversal risk; AAPL: watch for 1W reversal to re-establish trend (CORRECTION to be resolved); CHTR: watch for further downside momentum confirming BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+60): QCOM (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +22.77%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (beat) confirming price strength. V (+75): V (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-driven sentiment confirmed by strong price action. (Other high-sentiment names noted in feed but not shown with dual timeframe in this brief.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-50): META (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +24.75%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines partially reflected in near-term softness but 1M strength remains (divergence). WMT (-50): WMT (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +3.65%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirms near-term pressure. CHTR (-50): CHTR (1W: -34.57% | 1M: -28.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price strongly confirm downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech leadership but weak sector breadth. INTC, QCOM, NVDA, V and UNH are showing relative strength (INTC, QCOM, TXN, AMD, CVS ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major-cap divergence (AAPL, MSFT, JPM in CORRECTION) and concentrated Tech leadership (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Technology) that could trigger volatility if momentum falters.
